results.name: Initial enhanced collection
results.detail: All nine themes in original order, logo visible, count 9/9; labeled controls enabled only after initialization.

results.name: Name, case and surrounding whitespace
results.detail: Mixed-case padded Swiss query returns only Swiss; count 1/9 and logo remains visible.

results.name: Description matching and order
results.detail: Typography returns Editorial, Swiss and Gallery in original order; the Layered description matches independently.

results.name: Literal input and no-results state
results.detail: Regex punctuation is literal; a period matches descriptions, while a regex-shaped string and markup produce zero results without insertion.

results.name: Keyboard recovery
results.detail: Tab reaches Clear search with a visible focus outline; Enter restores all nine themes and returns focus to the input.

results.name: Enter, reload and link preservation
results.detail: Enter does not submit/navigate; reload clears the query; preview and logo hrefs remain unchanged.

results.name: Published preview navigation
results.detail: The filtered Swiss preview link loads its built theme page on localhost.

results.name: Narrow light appearance
results.detail: At 320 CSS px, controls stack, input/button are at least 48 px tall, search and empty state fit, no horizontal page overflow, clear restores results.

results.name: Narrow dark appearance
results.detail: At 320 CSS px, controls stack, input/button are at least 48 px tall, search and empty state fit, no horizontal page overflow, clear restores results.

results.name: Script disabled fallback
